title: Vertebral fracture and amputation
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's vertebral fracture or amputation (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/20/2026
Reason for Admission: Traumatic amputation of the right lower leg

Vitals: BP 118/74, HR 88, SpO2 98% on room air

Review of Systems:
Constitutional: Negative for fever, chills, or weight loss.
Musculoskeletal: Positive for right lower extremity pain and loss of function.
Neurological: Negative for numbness or tingling in upper extremities.
Skin: Positive for surgical site incision.

HPI: Patient is a 77-year-old female who presented to the emergency department following a farm machinery accident. She sustained a complete traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between the knee and ankle. Initial stabilization included hemorrhage control and irrigation.

Hospital Course: The patient was admitted for surgical revision and wound management. She underwent a surgical revision of the right lower leg site. Postoperative monitoring showed stable vitals and adequate perfusion to the remaining tissues. Pain management was titrated with intravenous and then oral analgesics. Wound care was provided daily, and the patient remained hemodynamically stable throughout the stay.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Traumatic amputation of the right lower leg between the knee and ankle

Discharge Medications:
- Acetaminophen 650mg every 6 hours as needed for pain
- Cephalexin 500mg every 8 hours for 7 days

Follow-up: Scheduled for wound check and surgical review in 10 days.

Electronically signed, R. Mensah, MD, 05/20/2026
